title: TS-68 Handoff step 4: infrastructure for the computer owner
description:
Source: the Pi session handoff spike (PR 474: spikes/pi-handoff, docs/PI_HARNESS.md section 'Spike: handoff to a computer owner', GO in steps) and docs/PI_SESSION_HANDOFF.md. Decision (user): the goal is a Pi session running in the computer container, using Pi's own tools (read, write, edit, bash from @earendil-works/pi-durable/tools), with the session portable between owners. Security gate before production: the container must not hold the model key or broad storage credentials.

CDK: the owner task role and the scoped role, the gateway route or Lambda, a take-over job on the start queue (the starter passes tenant, bot, channel and turn to the container), the OpenAI key never in the container, the old host-protocol claim path left in place until the cutover. Deploy through the repo workflows only. Then a live rehearsal on development (the user's go for each image push and task start).
right_now_summary: The infrastructure plan is defined, but deployment and live rehearsal have not started.
